courses.name: Bexley Golf Club
courses.notes: 18 holes, par 64 (eight par 3s, ten par 4s), 4,097 m off the blue tees: short, tight and tree-lined, with a couple of dams; the club says accuracy off the tee beats length and the par 4s tempt the driver. Public play seven days; public timesheets open online 14 days ahead (8 for weekends), you register once as a public player on the club's MiClub site, and weekend and public-holiday public bookings are online only, not through the pro shop. Check in at the pro shop 15 minutes before your time; a group of fewer than four may be filled. Cancellations need 12 hours' notice. Green fees (club site, Oct 2026): 18 holes $40 weekdays / $45 weekends, 9 holes $35 / $40, twilight after 3pm $30 / $35 unlimited, seniors and students $30 for 18 on weekdays; cart $45 for 18, $35 for 9. Weekday social bookings also by phone, 02 9150 9062, press 1 for the pro shop. Lengths in metres, blue (men's primary), white and the women's red; no handicap rating stored: none published by Golf Australia was found. Seen elsewhere: blue 62.4 / 106, white 61.1 / 104, red (women's) 65.6 / 104 (TheGrint), 61 SSS men / 63 women (Offcourse). Take the scratch rating and slope from the club's card or GolfLink. Stroke index: hole 17 hardest, 11 easiest, as Hole19 and TheGrint both list it; Offcourse and BlueGolf give other orders. The club's own scorecard PDF (bexleygolf.com.au, Score Card.pdf, 2019) could not be fetched from here; check this card against it when you have one in hand.
